report_plain: Clusters of tan-brown keratotic papules with a greasy surface are visible in a seborrhoeic distribution.
The lesion is symmetric and uniformly brown, with a smooth regular border and homogeneous pigmentation.
A sharply defined erythematous plaque has diffuse adherent silvery scale across its surface.
A coin-shaped erythematous patch shows fine scale and mild excoriation without a pearly border.
Open and closed comedones occur alongside scattered inflammatory papules on the facial skin.
A well-demarcated depigmented patch is present without scale, erythema, or surface textural change.
